notes: Mousin' Around power-up probe from the retained initialized NVRAM: the three trough switches (11-13) and the motor bank up switch (43) held from emulator start, so the ROM finds every ball accounted for and runs no ball search. The Auto-Up/Manual-Down switch (-6) is held at Auto-Up (1), the normal play position. No other host input; the harness never moves a ball or a mechanism.
